title: The Librarian: Quest for the Spear
description: A caretaker beneath a metropolitan library protects magical artifacts from those who would use them to do evil.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E01 — And the Crown of King Arthur
Someone is killing off potential Librarians, and it's up to Flynn Carsen and his new Guardian, Colonel Eve Baird, to save the three that are left.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E02 — And the Sword in the Stone
The Serpent Brotherhood is trying to return magic to the world; Flynn, Colonel Baird, and the potential Librarians must stop them before it's too late.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E03 — And the Horns of a Dilemma
The librarians' first solo mission hits a snag when Baird loses the others in a mysterious labyrinth that magically exists below the skyscraper of a modern corporation.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E04 — And Santa's Midnight Run
When the Serpent Brotherhood wants to kill Santa, the librarians must rescue him and help him accomplish the secret purpose of Christmas.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E05 — And the Apple of Discord
When the dragons sleeping beneath the earth threaten to awaken and wreak havoc around the world, Flynn returns to help find their hidden treasure.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E06 — And the Fables of Doom
The Librarians travel to a town where fairy tales are coming to life and attacking!

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E07 — And the Rule of Three
The librarians are forced to intercede when a group of competitive high school students start undercutting each other with witchcraft.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E08 — The Librarians and the Heart of Darkness
The librarians encounter the house behind the legend of all haunted houses and set out to destroy it.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E09 — And the City of Light
An investigation into a missing person uncovers what appears to be an alien invasion in a small town.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E10 — And the Loom of Fate
When Dulaque changes the course of fate, Baird begins moving through alternate timelines that reveal the changing destinies of the librarians.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E01 — The Nigerian Job
After recovering stolen airplane designs, Nate's team must figure out how to return them to the rightful owner.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E02 — The Homecoming Job
In order to help a wounded reservist, the team tries to expose the truth about a security firm.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E07 — The Wedding Job
The team poses as wedding planners to get close to a Mafia boss and must pull off a wedding while pulling off the heist.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E09 — The Snow Job
The team goes after a construction company that foreclosed on a National Guardsman's home; Nate puts the team in jeopardy with his drinking.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E08 — The Mile High Job
All the evidence the team seeks to expose a cover-up is on a plane heading to the Cayman Islands; airborne, the team uncovers a more sinister situation.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E03 — The Two Horse Job
The team travels to Kentucky to help a horse trainer who lost everything when the racehorses he trains were killed in a fire.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E05 — The Bank Shot Job
Nate, Sophie and the mark are taken hostage during a bank robbery; the team tries to help the two amateur and desperate robbers.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E04 — The Miracle Job
Nate helps his old friend Father Paul stop the demolition of his church. His means however, a fake miracle, are a lot less holy than his ends.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E06 — The Stork Job
The team goes after an adoption company that is scamming couples looking to adopt war orphans; the team hijacks the production of a horror movie.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E11 — The Juror No. 6 Job
One of Parker's aliases is chosen for jury duty; the team tries to stop someone from buying a favorable verdict in the trial.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E10 — The 12 Step Job
The team tricks an alcoholic financier into rehab to try to recover the money he swindled from a charity.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E12 — The First David Job
The team targets the CEO who denied Nate's son medical treatment.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E13 — The Second David Job
Nate comes out of hiding and tries to get his team back together to directly challenge Sterling and Blackpoole.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E01 — The Beantown Bailout Job
Nate reassembles the team to pit the local Irish mob against a banker who is gaming a government bailout.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E02 — The Tap-Out Job
The crew tries to get a corrupt mixed martial arts promoter to invest in a fake cable television network.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E03 — The Order 23 Job
The team goes after a shady hedge-fund manager; the mark is in the custody of the U.S. Marshals and is being hunted by the Armenian mob.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E04 — The Fairy Godparents Job
A clinic is forced to close because its funds were lost in a Ponzi scheme; the team goes after a corrupt investment banker who has money hidden from the authorities.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E05 — The Three Days of the Hunter Job
A TV host claims a school-bus driver caused an accident that left two children dead; Sophie takes the lead as the team sets out to put the host in her place.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E06 — The Top Hat Job
The team tries to infiltrate a corporation responsible for putting tainted food on the market.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E07 — The Two Live Crew Job
The team must go up against a crew of thieves in order to retrieve a priceless artwork.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E08 — The Ice Man Job
Hardison acts as the inside man when the team goes after an unscrupulous diamond merchant.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E09 — The Lost Heir Job
The team tries to stop a corrupt lawyer from taking over his client's estate.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E10 — The Runway Job
The team infiltrates the fashion world to take down a sweatshop owner.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E11 — The Bottle Job
The team runs a high-tech version of a classic con in order to save a bar from a loan shark.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S02 E04 — The Date Night Job
While staging a date-night experience for "Parker and Hardison" at a freeport facility, the team comes across another heist in progress and must stop it to save the life of a 13-year-old boy.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S02 E05 — A Walk in the Woods Job
While investigating the mysterious death of Eliot's friend, the team infiltrates an infamous enclave of power to take down the corrupt head of a private security company.

title: Almost Paradise
description:
S01 E07 — Uncle Danny
Alex's con-artist uncle comes for a visit to make amends and Alex finds himself caught between protecting the world from his uncle and protecting his uncle from Kai and Ernesto, as well as a mafia enforcer.

title: Almost Paradise
description:
S01 E08 — Lone Wolf
When Alex takes a job protecting a country singer he idolizes, he quickly learns that one should never meet one's heroes; when the singer is kidnapped, Alex must figure out who is really behind the crime and rescue him before it's too late.

title: The Ark
description:
S02 E01 — Failed Experiment
The crew must decide the best way forward with or without help from their nemesis, Evelyn Maddox.

title: The Ark
description:
S02 E02 — Kill or Be Killed
The arrival of new crew members presents questions of who can be trusted and what to do with them.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E09 — And the Feast of the Vampire
While on a visit to a small-town festival, Connor encounters the very first vampire, and finds himself fighting the clock to save himself from turning into one.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E10 — And Going Medieval
When Vikram attempts to return to 1847, via a homemade time machine, he inadvertently travels the entire team back to the days of King Arthur, where they learn the truth about a Knight of the Round Table, Camelot, and Elaine.

It's time to choose the Librarian who will be tethered to Baird, but no one can decide, so the Library comes up with a trial during which the Librarians will be reduced to their most primal selves and abandoned in nightmarish landscapes.

description:
S04 E12 — And the Echoes of Memory
The world is morphed into an unrecognizable place where the library never existed; Baird brings the librarians together in an attempt to prevent the bleak, new world from becoming the new reality.

S01 E09 — The Vex Rezicon
The Book of Names falls into enemy hands; the Prime Order settles into its new oppressive rule at the Outpost; Everit Dred has Gwynn trapped.

title: The Outpost
description:
S01 E10 — The Dragman Is Coming
Talon, Garret, and Janzo return from the Greyskin wastelands and find the Outpost very different from how they left it; Talon faces Dred, but is torn between getting revenge and saving her friends.

title: Almost Paradise
description:
S01 E09 — A Wedding to Die for
Alex's curiosity entangles him in Kai's undercover assignment at the wedding of a notorious triad boss, which turns ugly after a member of the wedding party is murdered.

description:
S01 E10 — Something Walker This Way Comes
Alex races to save his daughter when his old partner comes to town to finish the job he started.

Two theories on what could and shouldn't have been are revealed when two realities intertwine.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E11 — And the Graffiti of the Gods
Graffiti starts coming to life and threatening a teenage girl; the team must figure out how these strange events relate to Gregor's Hammer and Gregor's imminent return.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E12 — And the Unfinished Business
General Gregor retrieves the Sword of Mars and uses it to take over the country of Caucasylvia, gaining control of their nuclear arsenal; the team must steal the Sword to prevent world calamity.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S02 E06 — The Fractured Job
Eliot returns to his hometown and discovers that the runoff from an oil fracking company is now poisoning the water; the crew plots to take down the powerful man behind it all.

S02 E02 — Breaking Badminton
When Alex's friend from the local gym is found murdered, Alex investigates and discovers his friend was involved in an underground badminton competition; Alex and Ernesto must go undercover as badminton players to solve the murder.
